groups.title: The kairos command-line tool (login, profiles, data, cases, models, workflows, import, run); private, runs through tsx.

checks.why: types of the CLI
CLI, import and models tests

risks.text: Credentials (API key, session) are stored in plaintext in ~/.kairos/config.json (or KAIROS_CONFIG), mode 0600 in a 0700 directory; keep those modes.
Precedence is flag, then environment, then profile: KAIROS_API_KEY set in the shell overrides the profile's session login, so commands that need a signed-in person fail or hit another environment.
kairos profiles remove deletes the profile and its keys without confirmation, and import overwrites <file>.rejects.jsonl next to the input.

groups.title: The React + Vite operator console (decisions, entities, workflows, rulesets, lists, cases, settings), plus the plugin that builds the public /docs from the repository's docs/ folder.

checks.why: types of the console
console and server build; the docs plugin warns about customer pages that break the docs rules
every vitest suite: core, server (starts a throwaway Postgres), CLI, console, SDK, edge

risks.text: The API client types are written by hand with no shared schema: lists.readers expects {rulesets, workflows} from /v1/lists/:ref/readers, and ListPage falls back to [] so a server shape change compiles but silently shows an empty "Used by" card. The delete-blocked text comes from the server error; only the confirm text in ListPage names rulesets alone. (history 544cb7e)

Every request carries X-Kairos-Workspace and X-Kairos-Environment from module-level values; a call before setWorkspace/setEnvironment runs in the default scope. In dev the vite proxy lists the server prefixes (v1, auth, app, mcp): a new top-level server route needs an entry there.
Only pages listed in docs/pages.ts are published, in array order; a new .md in docs/ that is not listed is silently unpublished.

main.tsx runs the app in StrictMode, so mount effects run twice in dev; an effect that sends a write on mount would send it twice. Reviewed effects only GET (TwoFactor.tsx); about 137 useEffect calls exist and most were not audited. No import.meta.env is used except VITE_KAIROS_DOCS_URL and VITE_KAIROS_SHOW_GET_STARTED, which ship to the browser, so never put a secret in a VITE_ variable.
The server serves the built console only when KAIROS_CONSOLE is set, so the console must be built before the server build (build:standalone does both in order).

groups.title: Hono + Drizzle/Postgres API server and background worker: events, entities, decisions, workflows, rulesets, lists, cases, webhooks, sign-in and API keys.

checks.why: module layout, libs/ indexes, call direction and where SQL may run
types of the server
lists in workflows and missing ruleset inputs
every vitest suite: core, server (starts a throwaway Postgres), CLI, console, SDK, edge

risks.text: Deleting a list is refused only for readers that listsOfWorkflow and rulesetListSlugs can find: a string with a literal inList(value, 'slug'), or a node with type "list.*" and a string `list`. A new step type, a computed slug or a new kind of reader is missed, the delete succeeds and that reader breaks. (history 544cb7e)

A ruleset step resolves each input on its own and swallows only the ExpressionError that starts with "field not found: " (NOT_THERE), so an absent field becomes a missing input and fails only when the ruleset requires it. Changing that message, the regex or resolving the whole mapping at once makes absent fields fail the step. (history 544cb7e)

A module root may hold only index, route, service, repo, types and schema; every other file lives in libs/ behind libs/index.ts, and code outside imports <module>/libs, never a file in it. A file added at the root, or an import into libs/commands.ts directly, fails structure.test and the production Test stage. (history 4c4eaab)

Raw SQL through rows()/first() gets Postgres bigint and count(*) back as strings (node-postgres); cast counts ::int in the query or wrap in Number(), as catalog/repo.ts does. The seq columns are bigint mode number, safe only below 2^53.

Every outbound HTTP call (webhooks, the workflow http step, case media download) must go through guardedLookup/urlProblem, which refuse private addresses at connect time; a new fetch path that skips them opens SSRF to internal hosts.

groups.title: Claude Code project settings: strips agent attribution from commits and PRs.

risks.text: Keep includeCoAuthoredBy false and empty attribution: AGENTS.md forbids Co-Authored-By or generated-by lines in commits and PRs.

groups.title: The documentation, published at /docs by the console build and read by customers, operators (deployment/) and contributors (development/, not published).

checks.why: the docs build warns about customer pages that name server settings, broken links and images
fails when docs/templates/events pages differ from templates/events

risks.text: Customer pages must not name pnpm, localhost, repository paths or server settings (KAIROS_*, SUPABASE_*, DATABASE_URL); those go in docs/deployment/. The docs build warns, it does not fail.
docs/templates/events/*.md are generated from templates/events/*.json; edit the JSON and run pnpm docs:events, not the page.
A new page is published only when listed in apps/console/docs/pages.ts.
Run-time numbers in the notes (14 of 100 decisions, the baseline table) come from packages/eval; update docs/development/evaluation.md when eval:accept changes the baseline.

groups.title: End-to-end scenarios run with pnpm example:* against a local server.

checks.why: types of the examples

risks.text: Examples need KAIROS_API_KEY (a ksk_ secret key from the console) in .env and a running server with GRAYSON_API_KEY; they send real events and decisions to whatever KAIROS_URL points at.
They load action definitions from templates/, so editing a template changes what every example sends.

groups.title: The decision library: builds the context, asks the model (Grayson), then applies policy, rulesets, totals and scoring. Server, CLI and console import it as @kairos/core.

checks.why: types of core
core tests, incl. action templates and that docs/templates/events match templates/
catch rate and false-action rate against the accepted baseline

risks.text: Key order of the context is part of the model input: buildContext fixes the top-level order and baseline.ts sorts keys. Reordering or sorting changes answers (14 of 100 decisions with sorted keys vs 2 for a repeat of the same request).

decide throws when the model gives no hold answer, and a reason counts only at probability >= action.context.reasonThreshold (default 0.5); reason codes and questions come from the action definition, so editing templates/actions/*.json changes the model request and the policy.

The server stores what decide returns ({decision, context, raw}) in the decision log and webhook payloads; changing Decision, DecideResult or DecisionInput shapes breaks stored logs and payloads. About 100 imports of @kairos/core exist in apps/.
listSlugsIn finds lists in an expression only from a literal slug in inList(value, 'slug'); the server uses it to block deleting a list that is still read. A computed slug is invisible to it.

groups.title: @finic-ai/kairos-edge: Cloudflare Worker, Fastly Compute and Lambda@Edge handlers that run the client-settings routes at the edge and sign decisions for the origin.

checks.why: types of the edge package
edge handler tests

risks.text: The edge signs with Web Crypto and the SDK origin verifies with node createHmac; both must give the same hex for the same hashKey, or the origin ignores the x-kairos-edge signature and only logs a report.
Secrets come from the platform environment (KAIROS_API_KEY, KAIROS_HASH_KEY, KAIROS_URL; Fastly reads a secret store) and the client is cached on those values.

groups.title: The evaluation suite: 100 synthetic withdrawal cases through the real decide() with a file cache of model answers, compared with the accepted baseline.

checks.why: exits 1 if catch_rate falls or false_action_rate rises against accepted.json
types of the suite

risks.text: The cache key is a hash of JSON.stringify({model, context, questions}): any change in context content or key order, questions, reasons or model name is a cache miss and a live Grayson call (paid; throws without GRAYSON_API_KEY). Nothing prunes old files.

cache/ and cases/ are gitignored, so a fresh clone has neither: run pnpm eval:generate first. accepted.json is committed, so the first run compares fresh answers with a baseline from other cached answers.

The model is not repeatable (25 of 100 answers differed on a resend); a one-case difference is not a result. Use eval:accept only after a deliberate improvement and update the baseline table in evaluation.md.
The runner uses templates/actions/withdrawal.json, shared with the examples; editing it changes the eval requests and policy and needs a re-eval. Nothing in pnpm test fails when eval is skipped.

groups.title: @finic-ai/kairosid: device, visit and browser identifiers of a visitor for Kairos clients.

checks.why: types of kairosid
its tests

risks.text: The SDK depends on it as a workspace:* devDependency and it is built with tsc to dist; a change to the id format changes the cookies and device ids the SDK and edge send.

groups.title: @finic-ai/kairos, the TypeScript client: batched track, decide with fallback, Express/Hono middleware, browser client, edge settings routes.

checks.why: types of the SDK
client and middleware tests
tsup and tsc build to dist

risks.text: The Express middleware runs its edge and decide-route work in a detached async function with no try/catch and no error path to next(): if fromEdge or decideRoute throws, next() is never called and the request hangs. There is no four-argument error handler; the example relies on Express 5 forwarding rejected async handlers (it would hang on Express 4).

"Never throws" covers delivery only: track and decide with no entity throw KairosError, and decide without a fallback throws on timeout or error. track is queued (20 events or 2 s, drops the oldest when full), so call shutdown() before exit or events are lost.
In the repo, main/exports point at src/*.ts; only publishConfig swaps them to dist, so a path that works in the workspace can be missing from the published package.
ksk_ (secret) and kpk_ (public) are not enforced in code, only in docs: nothing stops a secret key being put in a browser bundle.

groups.title: finic-kairos, the stdlib-only Python port of the client, middleware, importer and training helpers.

checks.why: the Python SDK unit tests

risks.text: It mirrors the TypeScript SDK file by file (client, middleware, settings, webhooks) and nothing compares them: a change to hashing, the edge header or fallback must be made in both, and both are released together.
Must stay standard library only (dependencies = []).

groups.title: Workspace config: pnpm workspace, TS base, vitest, Docker, Vercel build, .env.example, AGENTS.md.

checks.why: every vitest suite: core, server (starts a throwaway Postgres), CLI, console, SDK, edge
types of every package
Prettier at width 120

risks.text: vercel.json builds with pnpm build:vercel && pnpm db:migrate: the build applies migrations, the function never does.
The root vitest config has a globalSetup that starts a throwaway embedded Postgres (or uses KAIROS_TEST_DATABASE_URL), so pnpm test needs that to be startable.
AGENTS.md sets branch names {type}/{name} and commit subjects {type}: Imperative message, with no agent attribution.

groups.title: dev.sh: runs the API, the console and optionally the worker in one terminal for development.

risks.text: Stops any process already listening on the API or console port before starting, so running it kills an unrelated server on 8787 or 5273.

groups.title: JSON templates for actions, entities, events, rulesets, case views and webhooks; also read by the server at run time and by the examples and eval.

checks.why: validates action templates and that the generated event docs match
rewrites docs/templates/events from the event templates

risks.text: The server loads templates from templates/ at run time (KAIROS_TEMPLATES, bundled beside the Vercel function); a ruleset file that is not valid is silently left out.
Changing an event template without pnpm docs:events fails the core test, since docs/templates/events is generated from it.
templates/actions/withdrawal.json is shared by the examples and the evaluation suite: change it only with a re-run of pnpm eval.

groups.title: Generated Drizzle SQL migrations and snapshots for the server's Postgres schema.

checks.why: regenerates from apps/server/src/db/schema so the snapshot matches the schema
applies the migrations to DATABASE_URL or the embedded Postgres

risks.text: A migration that has been merged or deployed must never be edited or deleted: a database may have run it. Add a new one instead.

A PR carries at most one migration; if the schema changes again in the PR, regenerate that one. With DATABASE_URL the server does not migrate on start: a deployment must run pnpm db:migrate, and there is no downgrade (restore a backup).

Hand-edit the SQL only where the generator cannot express the change (backfill, SQL function, special index), and say why in the PR. The SQL function kairos_id(prefix, time) from the baseline makes ids in the same format as newId.

rules.rule: A server module root holds only index, route, service, repo, types and schema (one of each); everything else sits in libs/ behind libs/index.ts, only repo.ts runs SQL, and imports flow route to service to repository.
rules.why: structure.test fails and the production Test stage stops the release (as in 4c4eaab).

rules.rule: Every place a password is set must use the password schema: at least 8 and at most 72 bytes.
rules.why: bcryptjs reads only 72 bytes, so a longer password is silently truncated and users could sign in with a different tail.

rules.rule: Every customer table and query is scoped by workspace_id and environment_id.
rules.why: Otherwise one customer's or sandbox's data leaks into another.

rules.rule: Values the model reads or a person wrote in an order (event and entity properties, action and entity definitions, the logged context) are json columns, not jsonb.
rules.why: jsonb sorts keys and key order changes the model's answers (14 of 100 evaluation decisions).

rules.rule: A PR has at most one migration, and a merged or deployed migration is never edited or deleted.
rules.why: A database may have already run it; editing it makes schemas diverge between installs.

rules.rule: A policy rule can only raise the outcome (approve, step_up, review, block), never lower it.
rules.why: A rule meant as a safeguard would turn a held or blocked action into an approval.

rules.rule: A change to the context builder, questions or policy is run through pnpm eval before it is kept.
rules.why: Small context changes move decisions and nothing in pnpm test catches it.

rules.rule: hashKey is the same on every server, the edge worker and the Python SDK (HMAC-SHA256 hex).
rules.why: Hashed fields and session cookies stop matching, and the origin ignores the edge's signed decision.

rules.rule: The console and the API share one origin (dev proxy or the server serving the build), with no CORS.
rules.why: The kairos_session cookie would not be sent and every call returns 401.

rules.rule: Customer docs pages never name server settings or repository paths; those belong in docs/deployment/.
rules.why: The public /docs would leak operator configuration; the docs build only warns.
